title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Coaches on the same page
hook: You and your assistant disagree during a game.
intro: They want to make a sub.
statement: Kids notice when the coaches are not on the same page.
q1: Do you settle disagreements away from the kids —
q2: or talk it through openly so kids see how adults decide?
q3: What do kids learn from watching you two?
t1: Every team is different. But players feel steady
t2: when the adults work as a team.
cta: Coaches — how do you work with assistants?
ctaLines: Plan before games. Talk privately. One voice.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
You and your assistant disagree during a game.
They want to make a sub. You want to wait.
Kids notice when the coaches are not on the same page.
Settle it privately or talk it through openly. There is no perfect answer.
How do you work with assistants? Share your habit in the comments.
